construction: Cell rule caps most cases below 2 months normal income or tags revolving/credit-constrained households; SCF bottom25 transaction median is about 0.35 months of median income and SHED shows the weakest emergency-savings rates among low-income/younger groups.

Uses SCF 50-75 net-worth transaction-account median around 1.9 months of median income, working-age median around 1.1 months, then adds savings/MMDA/CD liquidity and SHED three-month threshold evidence.
Retired/65+ SCF transaction medians are around 2-2.7 months of median income before CDs/MMFs; SHED 2025 has 71% of adults age 60+ with three-month savings, anchoring p25/p50 upward.

Operational cell requires liquid buffer >=6 months normal income and top/high financial assets; SCF top10 transaction median alone is about 4.4 months of median income before CDs/MMFs, so p10 floor is the cell rule.
